name: Sushil Mishra
headline: REALTOR® & Lifelong Learner in Real Estate Tech | Educator on AI, Social Media, and BoldTrail | Sharing My Learning Curve (So Yours is Smoother)|

sections.bio:
As a Real Estate Agent and Technology Coach, I specialize in empowering fellow real estate professionals with the tools and strategies needed to thrive in today's tech-driven market. At Catch The Key Inc., affiliated with RE/MAX West Realty Inc., I serve the Greater Toronto Area (GTA) and Greater Golden Horseshoe (GGH) with a dual focus: delivering exceptional real estate service to clients and coaching agents to leverage cutting-edge technology.

My passion lies in solving tech issues and sharing insights on everything from BoldTrail (formerly KV Core) and branding to SEO, social media strategies, and automation. I simplify complex concepts and turn them into practical solutions that agents can apply immediately. Whether it’s optimizing CRM systems, building a personal brand, or automating social media to save time and generate leads, I’m committed to helping agents level up their business.

In real estate, I combine advanced data-driven marketing with a client-centric approach. I guide homebuyers, sellers, and investors through every step, ensuring informed and confident decisions. My focus is on building long-term relationships and delivering results that matter.

Our family brand includes my wife, Himani Sood, who excels in client relations, and our golden retriever, Max The Golden Agent, the Chief Entertainment Officer. Together, we bring a personal touch and warmth to our professional service.

Key Highlights:

Tech Solutions Expert: Teaching agents about BoldTrail, branding, SEO, social media, and more, with a focus on practical, actionable strategies.
Real Estate Professional: Helping clients in the GTA and GGH markets make informed decisions using data and innovative marketing.
Community & Collaboration: Founder of the REAL TECH WhatsApp group, a hub for agents to share and solve tech-related challenges.
Certifications: Google Digital Marketing and SEO certified, always exploring the latest tools and trends to stay ahead.
If you’re an agent looking to optimize your tech game or a client needing expert guidance in real estate, let’s connect and achieve success together!

posts.text:
🏡🤖 Ontario REALTORS® - AI is changing how listings get written, leads get nurtured, and market data gets analyzed. I put together a free checklist of 5 AI tools that are actually worth your time (no fluff, no hype).

Grab it free here: https://lnkd.in/eMR2NyVN — it's part of The Real Tech, a newsletter for Ontario agents who want to stay ahead without wasting hours testing tools themselves.

sections.title: Why work with me
sections.body:
I provide direct access to an engaged niche of practicing real estate agents, team leads, and PropTech-focused professionals across Ontario and North America. Rather than generic reach, collaborations offer:

High-Intent B2B Relevance: My network is actively seeking practical AI, CRM automation, and marketing tools to streamline operations and close deals.

Active Practitioner Voice: As a licensed agent and technology coach, I present your product inside actual daily transaction workflows rather than surface-level feature tours.

Direct Implementation Focus: Content is built to solve real bottlenecks, driving qualified interest from agents ready to adopt new tech.

sections.title: How I work
sections.body:
Hands-on testing: I test your tool inside live real estate and marketing workflows before drafting content to ensure authentic positioning.

Workflow-led framing: Every post focuses on a specific problem, the solution your product provides, and an actionable takeaway for agents.

Collaborative review: Clear briefing, review milestones, and scheduled posting to align with your product launches or campaign goals.
